fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (NYSE:TSM) October revenue of NT$58.689 billion rose 14.7% month-over-month and grew 59.7% year-over-year; Wedbush reaffirmed 'outperform' rating and NT$3,300 price target.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC cumulative revenue for January–October of this year reached NT$4.49 trillion, up 43.3% year-over-year; sequential growth of approximately 13% expected for Q4.
